canonical_project: Vantage Bridgend data centre campus (CWL4, former Ford engine plant)

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Unanimous planning committee approval 2 Oct 2025 for a two-part Vantage application: first two-storey data centre at Waterton plus outline permission for a wider cluster of up to 10 buildings over 15-20 years; Senedd research cites ~600MW planned capacity; construction of the first building expected to start early 2026 with a ~2-year build.
